title: FLARE v7.14 Oregon sample: reconstructed spectral imagery, temperatures, FireScore and atmospheric state, July 16, 2026
description: 25 experimental native-grid scenes for July 16, 2026, 17:41–18:41 and 19:21–20:16 UTC. Zarr v2 and NetCDF4 preserve source values on a 545 by 1425 grid. Indexed XYZ tiles provide a sampled Web Mercator representation. Includes Python/Jupyter examples. Reconstructed values are not direct VIIRS observations. Radiance physical units remain unverified. FireScore is not a probability.
